jobs.title: Lead Sound Designer
jobs.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for an experienced Lead Sound Designer to join our studio in Warsaw to drive audio development of Witcher 4. As a Lead Sound Designer, you will be responsible for leading the Sound Design team and collaborating with cross-discipline teams to create and deliver an immersive audio experience for our upcoming game. If you are an accomplished game audio artist and experienced leader with a passion for crafting soundscapes for widely respected, narrative-driven RPGs, we want to hear from you! Daily Responsibilities: Lead a team of Sound Designers and drive game audio development in the project. Help define and maintain aesthetic continuity throughout the game and trailers, in alignment with previous releases in the IP where appropriate. Collaborate closely with project Directors, Leads, Producers, and cross-discipline teams (Music, VO, Programmers) to craft immersive, high-quality, and technologically advanced audio experiences. Plan, revise, track, and execute milestones, sprints, and roadmap deliverables. Support and coach team members to achieve impactful and high-quality in-game results while fostering their growth and development. Support the design and development of innovative audio systems using Unreal Engine 5, Wwise middleware, and in-house tools. Design, implement, and mix original and rich sound effects. 7+ years of professional experience in the video game industry, with involvement in multiple shipped AAA titles. At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role related to sound design or audio direction. Strong creative skills and a focus on quality, evidenced by a portfolio, demo reel, or game credits. Collaborative approach to navigating challenges and resolving design obstacles. Exceptional artistic and creative competence. Effective cross-disciplinary communication skills. Ability to manage timelines and coordinate with teams. Skilled communicator experienced in collaborating across development teams and providing supportive leadership to direct reports. Nice to Have: (These skills are not required to apply for the position) Experience with Atmos, Surround Sound, 3D Audio, and HRTF. Experience working with performance capture. Experience planning and executing field and Foley recording sessions. Working mode In-office in a hybrid or full-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland. Relocation is required. Relocation Support Relocation package — flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet and family, shipping your belongings. It’s all covered. Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you and  tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Paid Leave — from 20 to 26 days of holiday per year, and paid sick leave. Health & Well-Being Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company. Perks & Professional Growth A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! Social Activities & Life in the Office Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio. Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has  electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog . A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them. An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes. No dress-code — we like to keep it casual. Estimated pay range for this position: 31 800 – 43 725 PLN gross monthly. This role may be eligible for a long term incentive program (option to purchase CDPR stock after the vesting period). Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications. Type of contract: Employment Contract ("Umowa o pracę"). jobs.title: Audio Artist - EA Sports NHL
jobs.description:
Audio Artist - EA Sports NHL - 216383 - Electronic Arts Skip to content Electronic Arts Open Roles About EA EA Careers EA News Login English - US Chinese English - US Finnish Français Italian Korean Malay Polish Romanian Spanish Swedish Audio Artist - EA Sports NHL Home ... Open Roles Role Detail General Information Locations : Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada Role ID 216383 Worker Type Temporary Employee Studio/Department EA Studios - SPORTS Work Model Hybrid Description & Requirements Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. Audio Artist II – Speech Production EA SPORTS™ NHL Who We Are EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games. EA SPORTS NHL has revolutionised sports gaming for millions of players worldwide. We've pioneered award-winning creative technology and experiences to connect players to the speed, skill, and heart of the NHL. Role Overview We are looking for an Audio Artist II to join the EA SPORTS NHL Audio team. The primary focus of this role is mastering, organising, and delivering high-quality recorded speech for commentary, voice-over, and other in-game experiences. You will also support speech-production workflows using AI tools that help the team maintain content at scale. Reporting to the Audio Lead, you will work independently within a defined area, applying editorial judgement and technical discipline to ensure assets meet creative, pipeline, and in-game quality standards. The Challenge Ahead Your challenge will be to turn recorded and generated source material into game-ready assets while maintaining accuracy across naming, metadata, versioning, and delivery. You will review content critically and work with speech leads, audio leadership, production, and technical partners to resolve issues. You will contribute ideas within your area, help improve established workflows, estimate your work with guidance, and communicate status, dependencies, and risks early. Who You Are You are an audio professional with dialogue-editing and mastering skills. You are comfortable working through high volumes of content without losing consistency, and you understand how editorial choices affect clarity, authenticity, and the player experience. You evaluate and integrate new tools through active testing and structured analysis. You will review audio outputs to identify artifacts and inconsistencies, correct manageable issues through direct editing, and escalate complex problems to the speech team. You will maintain structured asset workflows, integrate team reviews into your daily process, and implement solutions to increase our audio processing pipeline's reliability. Responsibilities Master, clean, and quality-check commentary, dialogue, and other speech assets. Use approved speech-generation and processing tools to create or adapt content, then evaluate and prepare outputs to team standards. Identify issues involving noise, level, dynamics, spectral balance, timing, pronunciation, continuity, or processing artifacts. Maintain accurate naming, metadata, versioning, source files, and delivery structures. Prepare, import, and validate speech assets in game-audio tools, databases, and established pipelines. Track assigned work, provide estimates with lead support, and communicate priorities, dependencies, and schedule risks. Participate in troubleshooting and recommend practical improvements to tools and workflows. Document processes and share knowledge. Requirements Professional experience editing and mastering dialogue, commentary, VO, ADR, broadcast, or comparable speech content. Advanced proficiency with Pro Tools or another professional DAW, including dialogue cleanup, EQ, dynamics, noise reduction, loudness control, and batch workflows. Demonstrated experience evaluating audio to identify subtle quality, consistency, and processing errors. 3+ years of experience managing assets against technical specifications, naming conventions, metadata, and version-control requirements. Experience with game-audio authoring tools, databases, or content pipelines. You will document technical workflows, track project milestones, and coordinate asset deliveries across multiple technical and creative departments. Experience with modern speech-production, voice-processing, automation, or scripting workflows is an asset. Pay Transparency - North America COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs). PAY RANGES * British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$67,000 - $92,700 CAD Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA. In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, and extended health/dental/vision coverage and basic life insurance. About Electronic Arts We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth. We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do. Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law. jobs.title: Concepteur audio technique / Technical Audio Designer
jobs.description: En tant que concepteur audio technique, vous vous situez à l’intersection du design sonore et de l’ingénierie, transformant les éléments audio en systèmes en jeu performants et peaufinés. En collaboration avec les concepteurs sonores, les ingénieurs et les concepteurs techniques, vous intégrerez l’audio dans Unreal Engine et Wwise, concevrez des outils et optimiserez les performances. Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique destiné à une personne souhaitant évoluer à la jonction de la création et de la technique. Contrat de 12 mois Responsabilités: Intégrer les éléments audio dans Unreal Engine à l’aide du moteur sonore Wwise, de l’élément source jusqu’au système jouable. Concevoir et maintenir des systèmes audio basés sur les Blueprints. Développer et améliorer des outils permettant d’accélérer le flux de travail des concepteurs sonores. Profiler et optimiser l’audio en termes de CPU, mémoire, nombre de voix et flux (streaming) à l’aide du Wwise Profiler et d’Unreal Audio Insights. Respecter les directives d’organisation des données et de mixage de Wwise afin de garantir la cohérence du contenu et sa capacité à passer à l’échelle. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes audio en collaboration avec l’équipe de développement. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique des fonctionnalités, outils et flux de travail audio. Communiquer clairement les progrès et les contraintes techniques aux collaborateurs non techniques. Exigences: 3 ans ou plus d’expérience en audio technique, incluant un cycle de production complet jusqu’au lancement du jeu. Compétences démontrables en intégration audio avec Unreal Engine et Wwise. Solide maîtrise des Blueprints Unreal pour l’intégration audio. Maîtrise de Wwise. Connaissance pratique d’une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) telle que Reaper ou Pro Tools. Fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et souci du détail. Capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies, outils et concepts. Bonnes aptitudes en communication et travail d’équipe, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des contraintes techniques à des collaborateurs non techniques. Intérêt réel pour l’audio technique appliqué au jeu vidéo, couplé à une bonne oreille. Atouts: Bonne compréhension de Wwise Spatial Audio. Connaissance pratique de l’API Wwise Authoring (WAAPI). Compétences en programmation d’scripts en Python ou C#. Connaissance de base du C++ et de son rôle dans Unreal Engine. Technical Audio Designer As a Technical Audio Designer, you sit between sound design and engineering, turning audio assets into polished, performant in-game systems. Working with audio designers, engineers, and technical designers, you will implement audio in Unreal Engine and Wwise, build tooling, and optimize for performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to grow at the intersection of creative and technical craft. 12-month contract Responsibilities: Integrate audio assets into Unreal Engine using the Wwise sound engine, from source asset to playable system. Build and maintain Blueprint-based audio systems. Develop and improve tools that speed up the audio designers' workflow. Profile and optimize audio for CPU, memory, voice count, and streaming using the Wwise Profiler and Unreal Audio Insights. Uphold Wwise data organization and mixing guidelines so content stays consistent and scales across the project. Troubleshoot and resolve audio issues in collaboration with the development team. Write and maintain technical documentation for audio features, tools, and workflows. Communicate progress and technical constraints clearly to non-technical collaborators. Required: 3+ years of technical audio experience, including one full production cycle through ship. Demonstrable audio implementation skills with Unreal Engine and Wwise. Strong command of Unreal Blueprints for audio implementation. Proficient with Wwise. Working knowledge of a DAW such as Reaper or Pro Tools. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to quickly learn new technology, tools, and concepts. Good communication and teamwork abilities, including explaining technical constraints to non-technical collaborators. Genuine interest in technical audio for games, with a good ear. Nice to have: Good understanding of Wwise Spatial Audio. Working knowledge of the Wwise Authoring API (WAAPI). Scripting abilities in Python or C#. Surface level understanding of C++ and its role in Unreal Engine. Justification des exigences linguistiques NetEase s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail francophone pour ses employés au Québec. Tous les efforts ont été faits pour éviter d'exiger une langue autre que le français pour ce poste. Cependant, la maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle pour ce poste, car l'employé devra communiquer régulièrement avec des collègues et des parties prenantes situés à l'extérieur du Québec, où l'anglais est la principale langue de communication entre les bureaux. Language Requirement Justification NetEase is committed to supporting a French-speaking workenvironment for its employees in Quebec. Every effort has been made to avoidrequiring a language other than French for this position. However, proficiency in English is essential for thisrole because the employee will be required to communicate regularly with colleagues and stakeholders located outside Quebec, where English is theprimary language of communication between offices.

jobs.title: Composer / Sound Designer
jobs.description: About Playtech Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience. As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices. Ready to level up your career? Playtech's Sound team is looking for a talented Composer/Sound Designer to collaborate with our international team and create immersive in-game music, design sound effects, and prepare sound packages for our online slot games. HOW TO APPLY? A portfolio showcasing music and sound design work created for slot games is a mandatory part of the application. Please submit your CV together with multiple relevant work samples and, where possible, video demonstrations of completed projects. Your influential mission. You will... Create in-game music in a variety of genres for online slot games. Design sound effects and musical parts for animations and game events. Prepare game packages in a variety of sound formats. Edit and mix sound for promo videos. Components for success. You... Possess 1+ years of experience in composing and sound design in the slot industry. Ability to provide examples of completed slot game work, ideally including video demonstrations of the final implementation. Have a passion for composing music and creating engaging audio experiences for players. Have access to a home studio with your own music production setup and extensive SFX libraries. Have experience composing original music across multiple genres, including orchestral, traditional, rock, electronic, and dance. Have a strong understanding of adaptive and interactive game audio, including loopable music, gameplay-driven transitions, anticipation builds, and bonus stingers. Are experienced creating high-quality sound effects for games and interactive products. Demonstrate strong audio editing, arranging, mixing, and mastering skills. Possess advanced proficiency with professional DAWs such as Ableton, Nuendo, Pro Tools, or similar. Have strong knowledge of industry-standard plugins, virtual instruments, and modern music production workflows. Are comfortable playing and recording musical instruments as part of the creative process. Understand player behaviour and the role audio plays in engagement and game performance. Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with designers, artists, developers, product teams, and external partners. Are able to work independently and confidently guide the creative direction of projects through music references and concepts. Communicate proficiently in English. You'll get extra points for... Prior experience in the gaming/slot industry. Thrive in a culture that values... Initiative-taking and confident approach at the workplace. Global scope and inclusive working environment. Constant learning and development opportunities. Active lifestyle and mental well-being. Fun and engaging company events. SOUND TEAM There are several global game production studios within the Playtech family. Each studio is made up of Game Producers, Artists, Animators, Mathematicians, and Developers who collaborate to create high‑quality content for top‑performing games. These games are then distributed to our clients and players around the world. As a Composer/Sound Designer, you will be part of our Ash studio sound creative team and work closely with Game Producers and Studio Artists to bring our content to life through music and sound effects. Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

jobs.title: SENIOR SOUND DESIGNER
jobs.description: We’re looking for a Senior Sound Designer to help bring Wardogs to life through impactful, high-quality audio that makes every encounter feel responsive, immersive and competitive. You’ll take ownership of key audio features across the game, from weapons and combat feedback to player movement and environments. Working closely with our Audio Director and the wider development team, you’ll help shape the audio experience from initial concept through to implementation and ship. As a passionate FPS player, you understand how much sound matters in a shooter. From recognising an enemy’s position to feeling the weight of a weapon, great audio gives players the information they need to make split-second decisions. You’ll bring that understanding into your work, helping us deliver an audio experience that stands up against the best shooters out there. This is a hands-on senior role where you’ll have the freedom to own features, solve technical challenges and influence how we approach audio across the game. You’ll also support and mentor other sound designers, helping raise the quality of the work around you. What you’ll do: Own the design and implementation of major audio features across Wardogs, including weapons, combat feedback, player movement and environments. Build and maintain MetaSound sources and patches to create dynamic, responsive and performant audio systems. Design audio that supports gameplay clarity, with a strong understanding of spatialisation, positional cues and mix priorities during intense combat. Work closely with designers, programmers and artists to shape features where audio is central to the player experience. Collaborate with the Audio Director to deliver the game's audio vision, contributing to documentation, style guides and best practices. Work with programmers and AI to improve audio tools, pipelines and workflows. Mentor and support junior and mid-level sound designers, sharing knowledge and providing constructive feedback. Play and critically review the game regularly, identifying issues, exploring opportunities and pushing audio quality towards a polished, shippable standard. Monitor audio performance and memory budgets, optimising content and systems where needed. Take a proactive approach to problem-solving, identifying risks early and working with the team to find solutions. What we're looking for: Several years of experience in game audio, including at least one shipped title in a senior or feature-owning role. A genuine passion for FPS games, with a strong understanding of what makes shooter audio effective, readable and satisfying. A strong sound design portfolio showcasing distinctive, high-impact audio. Weapon and combat audio experience is particularly welcome. Hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5, MetaSounds and Blueprints. A solid understanding of 3D audio, spatialisation, attenuation and mixing for competitive gameplay. The ability to take ownership of features from concept through to implementation, with minimal supervision. Strong communication skills and the confidence to collaborate across disciplines, explain audio decisions and give constructive feedback. A proactive, organised approach, with the ability to balance creative ambition with technical requirements and performance constraints.

new_jobs.title: Concepteur audio technique / Technical Audio Designer
new_jobs.description: En tant que concepteur audio technique, vous vous situez à l’intersection du design sonore et de l’ingénierie, transformant les éléments audio en systèmes en jeu performants et peaufinés. En collaboration avec les concepteurs sonores, les ingénieurs et les concepteurs techniques, vous intégrerez l’audio dans Unreal Engine et Wwise, concevrez des outils et optimiserez les performances. Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique destiné à une personne souhaitant évoluer à la jonction de la création et de la technique. Contrat de 12 mois Responsabilités: Intégrer les éléments audio dans Unreal Engine à l’aide du moteur sonore Wwise, de l’élément source jusqu’au système jouable. Concevoir et maintenir des systèmes audio basés sur les Blueprints. Développer et améliorer des outils permettant d’accélérer le flux de travail des concepteurs sonores. Profiler et optimiser l’audio en termes de CPU, mémoire, nombre de voix et flux (streaming) à l’aide du Wwise Profiler et d’Unreal Audio Insights. Respecter les directives d’organisation des données et de mixage de Wwise afin de garantir la cohérence du contenu et sa capacité à passer à l’échelle. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes audio en collaboration avec l’équipe de développement. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique des fonctionnalités, outils et flux de travail audio. Communiquer clairement les progrès et les contraintes techniques aux collaborateurs non techniques. Exigences: 3 ans ou plus d’expérience en audio technique, incluant un cycle de production complet jusqu’au lancement du jeu. Compétences démontrables en intégration audio avec Unreal Engine et Wwise. Solide maîtrise des Blueprints Unreal pour l’intégration audio. Maîtrise de Wwise. Connaissance pratique d’une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) telle que Reaper ou Pro Tools. Fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et souci du détail. Capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies, outils et concepts. Bonnes aptitudes en communication et travail d’équipe, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des contraintes techniques à des collaborateurs non techniques. Intérêt réel pour l’audio technique appliqué au jeu vidéo, couplé à une bonne oreille. Atouts: Bonne compréhension de Wwise Spatial Audio. Connaissance pratique de l’API Wwise Authoring (WAAPI). Compétences en programmation d’scripts en Python ou C#. Connaissance de base du C++ et de son rôle dans Unreal Engine. Technical Audio Designer As a Technical Audio Designer, you sit between sound design and engineering, turning audio assets into polished, performant in-game systems. Working with audio designers, engineers, and technical designers, you will implement audio in Unreal Engine and Wwise, build tooling, and optimize for performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to grow at the intersection of creative and technical craft. 12-month contract Responsibilities: Integrate audio assets into Unreal Engine using the Wwise sound engine, from source asset to playable system. Build and maintain Blueprint-based audio systems. Develop and improve tools that speed up the audio designers' workflow. Profile and optimize audio for CPU, memory, voice count, and streaming using the Wwise Profiler and Unreal Audio Insights. Uphold Wwise data organization and mixing guidelines so content stays consistent and scales across the project. Troubleshoot and resolve audio issues in collaboration with the development team. Write and maintain technical documentation for audio features, tools, and workflows. Communicate progress and technical constraints clearly to non-technical collaborators. Required: 3+ years of technical audio experience, including one full production cycle through ship. Demonstrable audio implementation skills with Unreal Engine and Wwise. Strong command of Unreal Blueprints for audio implementation. Proficient with Wwise. Working knowledge of a DAW such as Reaper or Pro Tools. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to quickly learn new technology, tools, and concepts. Good communication and teamwork abilities, including explaining technical constraints to non-technical collaborators. Genuine interest in technical audio for games, with a good ear. Nice to have: Good understanding of Wwise Spatial Audio. Working knowledge of the Wwise Authoring API (WAAPI). Scripting abilities in Python or C#. Surface level understanding of C++ and its role in Unreal Engine. Justification des exigences linguistiques NetEase s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail francophone pour ses employés au Québec. Tous les efforts ont été faits pour éviter d'exiger une langue autre que le français pour ce poste. Cependant, la maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle pour ce poste, car l'employé devra communiquer régulièrement avec des collègues et des parties prenantes situés à l'extérieur du Québec, où l'anglais est la principale langue de communication entre les bureaux. Language Requirement Justification NetEase is committed to supporting a French-speaking workenvironment for its employees in Quebec. Every effort has been made to avoidrequiring a language other than French for this position. However, proficiency in English is essential for thisrole because the employee will be required to communicate regularly with colleagues and stakeholders located outside Quebec, where English is theprimary language of communication between offices.

new_jobs.title: SENIOR SOUND DESIGNER
new_jobs.description: We’re looking for a Senior Sound Designer to help bring Wardogs to life through impactful, high-quality audio that makes every encounter feel responsive, immersive and competitive. You’ll take ownership of key audio features across the game, from weapons and combat feedback to player movement and environments. Working closely with our Audio Director and the wider development team, you’ll help shape the audio experience from initial concept through to implementation and ship. As a passionate FPS player, you understand how much sound matters in a shooter. From recognising an enemy’s position to feeling the weight of a weapon, great audio gives players the information they need to make split-second decisions. You’ll bring that understanding into your work, helping us deliver an audio experience that stands up against the best shooters out there. This is a hands-on senior role where you’ll have the freedom to own features, solve technical challenges and influence how we approach audio across the game. You’ll also support and mentor other sound designers, helping raise the quality of the work around you. What you’ll do: Own the design and implementation of major audio features across Wardogs, including weapons, combat feedback, player movement and environments. Build and maintain MetaSound sources and patches to create dynamic, responsive and performant audio systems. Design audio that supports gameplay clarity, with a strong understanding of spatialisation, positional cues and mix priorities during intense combat. Work closely with designers, programmers and artists to shape features where audio is central to the player experience. Collaborate with the Audio Director to deliver the game's audio vision, contributing to documentation, style guides and best practices. Work with programmers and AI to improve audio tools, pipelines and workflows. Mentor and support junior and mid-level sound designers, sharing knowledge and providing constructive feedback. Play and critically review the game regularly, identifying issues, exploring opportunities and pushing audio quality towards a polished, shippable standard. Monitor audio performance and memory budgets, optimising content and systems where needed. Take a proactive approach to problem-solving, identifying risks early and working with the team to find solutions. What we're looking for: Several years of experience in game audio, including at least one shipped title in a senior or feature-owning role. A genuine passion for FPS games, with a strong understanding of what makes shooter audio effective, readable and satisfying. A strong sound design portfolio showcasing distinctive, high-impact audio. Weapon and combat audio experience is particularly welcome. Hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5, MetaSounds and Blueprints. A solid understanding of 3D audio, spatialisation, attenuation and mixing for competitive gameplay. The ability to take ownership of features from concept through to implementation, with minimal supervision. Strong communication skills and the confidence to collaborate across disciplines, explain audio decisions and give constructive feedback. A proactive, organised approach, with the ability to balance creative ambition with technical requirements and performance constraints.
